# BizFlow — Design Notes

Source: ColorLib Busicol (https://colorlib.com/wp/template/busicol/)
Preview: https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/busicol/
New name: bizflow

## Structure Order

1. Navbar (sticky, nav links)
2. Hero Slider (3 slides, dark overlay, CTAs)
3. Services (3 cards)
4. About (text + CTA)
5. Counter (3 statistics)
6. Gallery/Portfolio (5 items)
7. Features (3 cards)
8. Financial Solution (2-column)
9. Testimonials (carousel)
10. CTA/Project (call-to-action)
11. Footer (multi-column)

## Section-by-Section Fidelity Notes

### Navbar
- Fixed top navigation
- Logo on left, nav links on right
- Links: Home, Services, About, Portfolio, Blog, Contact

### Hero Slider
- Full-width carousel with 3 slides
- Each slide: "Grow Big with Musicol Business" heading
- Description paragraph
- "Our Services" + "See How it Work" CTA buttons
- Dark semi-transparent overlay

### Services
- "Explore Our Solutions" heading
- 3 service cards in a row
- Each card: icon, title, description
- Services: Invoicing, Business Growth, Problem Solving

### About
- "The Largest Business Expert" heading
- Description paragraph
- "About Us" CTA button

### Counter
- 3 statistics in a row
- Animated counters on scroll
- Stats: 520+ Total Projects, 244 On Going, 95% Job Success

### Gallery/Portfolio
- "Our Recent Works" heading
- 5 portfolio items in a grid
- Each item: image, "Product Branding" title
- "More Works" CTA button

### Features
- 3 feature cards in a row
- Each card: icon, title, description
- Features: Unlimited Control, Rapidly Growth, Problem Solving

### Financial Solution
- "Gives you the best Financial solution for business" heading
- 2-column layout with content on each side

### Testimonials
- Carousel with testimonial quotes
- Author name and role below each quote
- Robert Jonson, Business Owner

### CTA/Project
- "Do you Have any Project?" heading
- Description paragraph
- "Contact Us" CTA button

### Footer
- Multi-column layout
- Services links, Useful Links, Address
- Contact info
- Copyright notice
- "Made with Component Dock" branding

## Design Token Summary

- Primary green: #28AE60
- Secondary orange: #ff5e13
- Body font: Poppins (sans-serif)
- Button style: sharp edges (border-radius: 0)
- Page background: #fbf9ff (off-white)
- Footer background: #2C2C2C (dark)
